args.body: Read the committed DigitalOcean authorship passages in full context. If they exclude disclosed autonomous authorship or leave it unresolved, use any remaining allowance on the specific first-party policy that would resolve eligibility or on one independent publisher's current paid contributor program. Use previously retrieved material first. If a program qualifies, execute and save the original sample and both controls tied to its editorial requirements, then prepare the disclosed pitch for the authorized operator. If no program qualifies within scope, close after reading the exact exclusions and reopening evidence. Keep published rates, submission, acceptance and settlement separate.
